images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high-fidelity Rakky Ride mobile app design proposal for approval before coding. Produce ONE complete portrait screen per image, about 403 x 850 logical pixels rendered crisply at high resolution, matching the supplied fictional Vehicle & documents design reference. White forward, forest green #176B17, pale mint #EAF5E5, silver #EEF1EC, charcoal #141A14, fine silver borders; green for approved, amber for review, red only for problems. Very compact 13px body/helper text and 15px medium headers, small conventional outline symbols 16–18px, accessible 44px controls. No large headlines, no oversized icons, no giant illustrations, no dark background, no gradient, no phone hardware frame, no map, no brand logo. Entire screen and bottom safe area visible, no clipping. Match card radii, alignment and thin dividers. Fictional data only. Reference is for style only; do not copy vehicle plate or document content into unrelated sections.
Primary request: redesign the separate Application status page for an existing driver partner. Top status bar and compact header with 44px circular back arrow, title "Application status", small refresh outline icon with a touch target at the right.

A short mint summary card: small outlined shield/check circle at left (32px), at right heading "Application approved" (15px), one concise helper sentence "Your driver application is approved." No celebratory oversized check.

Section "Application summary": white thin-border grouped card with THREE compact rows, small outline icons and left muted labels / right values:
"Submitted" / "19 Oct 2026"
"Reviewed" / "21 Oct 2026"
"Vehicle category" / "Car"
These are fictional metadata, NOT a verification checklist. Do not add identity verification checkmarks or document validity claims.

Section "Service approvals": a white bordered group with TWO compact rows separated by hairline:
small green generic car outline in a 30px silver square, title "Passenger rides", right small green pill "Approved";
small package outline in a 30px silver square, title "Courier deliveries", right neutral silver pill "Not requested".
Below the group a quiet small info line "Ride and courier are reviewed separately."

Then a small silver informational card with a tiny sliders/settings glyph and brief text "Choose which approved requests you receive from your dashboard." This is explanatory, no toggle, and no action that auto-enables service requests.

At bottom two compact full-width controls: green outline "Service applications" with small package/chevron symbol, then primary forest green "Go to driver dashboard" with small car symbol and white label. Below small green "Help & support" link with headset glyph. No huge vertical empty gap; align the content naturally and give the bottom safe area room. This page has overall application approval but courier NOT requested; do not imply all services are approved. Avoid request switches, progress percentages, invented estimated review times, personal names, private identifiers or money.

Primary request: redesign the separate Service applications screen for a driver who already has Passenger rides approved and is choosing to apply for courier. Narrow status bar and compact header with circular back arrow and title "Service applications".

First a short mint intro strip with small package icon, heading "Add another service", helper "Your approved service stays available."

Section "Current service": small white bordered informational row: small car glyph left, "Passenger rides" middle, green status pill "Approved" at right. This row is not selectable and has no request toggle.

Section "Vehicle type": two compact equal selectable cards side by side. Car card selected with thin forest-green border, very SMALL generic green stylized 3D car (44x28 logical pixels max) or outline car, label "Car", selected radio indicator. Motorcycle card silver border, small conventional motorcycle outline icon, label "Motorcycle", unselected radio. Tiny helper below "Motorcycles support courier deliveries only." This is a sample where category choice is available; not a vehicle editing form.

Section "Apply for": ONE compact bordered courier selection card with pale mint selected state and small package icon left. Title "Courier deliveries", small subtitle "Deliver sealed packages up to 5 kg.", small selected radio on right. No Passenger rides or Both services option since passenger rides are already approved.
Small muted helper "New services require approval."

Then a white thin-border disclosure row with small document glyph and chevron-down, label "Courier service details"; small subordinate text "Read pickup, delivery and return requirements." This disclosure reveals the existing full service consent wording when expanded, but is collapsed in this preview. Do not print invented terms in the picture.

Under it a silver consent box with clearly EMPTY UNCHECKED square, existing exact concise text "I choose these services and understand the request preferences above." This checkbox is not prechecked. Label wraps naturally in small 13px text.

Then visibly DISABLED silver/grey full-width button "Submit service selection", NOT green (consent has not been accepted); tiny muted helper "Accept the service choice to continue." Below a green outline full-width "Back to dashboard" button. All controls are compact and the page has a clear bottom safe area. Avoid large marketing artwork, fake checkmarks on documents, automatic consent, uploading files again, or claims that submitting grants immediate approval.
